text: Because some hedge fund trading strategies depend on the immediate availability of capital and will not work without sufficient lines of credit, banks may retain enough influence over hedge funds even where funds use multiple lenders.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Regulation Via Basel III (2011). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1806252

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Regulation Via Basel III

abstract: Without sufficient lines of credit to supply required additional capital, these trading strategies may not work. Perhaps banks will have enough influence over hedge funds even if hedge funds have multiple lending relationships.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: fund uses dynamic trading strategies requiring additional capital on short notice
